title: N63: Paper scope analysis — 5 contributions are thematically linked, recommend keeping
description: Analyzed N39 question about splitting into 2 papers. The 5 contributions form a coherent chain: (1) leverage direction taxonomy → (2) model selection rule → (3) VaR improvement → (4) GARCH ceiling → (5) Hybrid VT. Removing any one weakens the narrative. Alternative: reframe as 3 main contributions (leverage taxonomy, VaR attribution, Hybrid VT) with 2 supporting results (ceiling, model selection). The ceiling result (Contribution 4) is the weakest for standalone publication since it's essentiall
